description: Takes a resume and job description, then produces optimized resume sections. Rewrites professional summary, experience bullet points, and skills section to better align with the target job. Provides before/after comparisons and specific improvement suggestions.

example_response.optimized_summary: Results-driven software engineer with 5+ years of experience in full-stack development...

optimized_bullets.optimized: Architected and deployed scalable backend microservices handling 10K+ requests/second, reducing latency by 40%
optimized_bullets.improvement_note: Added quantifiable metrics and action verbs to demonstrate impact

example_response.overall_assessment: Your resume has strong foundations but needs more targeted keywords and quantifiable results.
